## Structure

    [provider]/
      {provider}.ts  the provider's entry point
      [helper].ts    a helper

Zero or more `[provider]/` directories may exist. For each one that does,
{provider}.ts is required. Zero or more files matching `[provider]/[helper].ts`
may exist. Nothing else may exist under clients/.
